summary: Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SILC) filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that an AI infrastructure challenger selected its inference-specific solution for PoC efforts targeting Tier-1 hyperscalers, with initial orders placed for H1 2026 delivery and PoC scheduled for H2 2026. This is a routine business development announcement regarding a customer selection and product deployment. No specific terms, board actions, advisor names, or deal mechanics are disclosed. The filing does not constitute a special situation; it is an ordinary press release regarding product traction. There are no deal terms to record.
